 New York features some key battleground races where both Democrats and Republicans believe the demographics are working in their favor. The most pivotal may be in the 17th, where Republican Rep. Mike Lawler is running against Democrat Cait Conley, a former national security official, in a district that Vice President Kamala Harris narrowly won in 2024.
